numbering_note: This doc's rules are R1-R8/W1-W2. They are stored here as DP1-DP8/W1-W2 because tools/static_design_gate.py already owns R1-R8 for a different (camera/pacing) rule set, and lines/nalu/runtime/tools/nalu_writer_selfcheck_seq29.py already owns R5A-R9B for a third. doc_ref below is the original R-number for traceability.
missing_file_behavior: A deployment with no DIRECTION_POLICY_V1.json gets an empty policy from every loader (see tools/reroll_cost_guard.py / lines/nalu/runtime/tools/nalu_tail_ad_opt_in.py's read_json convention) — every DPn/Wn check below then no-ops. A contract without direction_policy.enforced=true also only reports, never blocks (mirrors nalu_writer_selfcheck_seq29.py's own enforced gate).

DP3_dialogue_continuity.status: NEW — tightens the existing 5s/0.35 thresholds (nalu_writer_selfcheck_seq29.py R5C; build_e0N_layers.py's own dialogue-ratio assert) to Roger's explicit 3s/0.75

DP5_speech_rate_no_literal_number.status: FIXED_2026-09-27 — the 2026-09-25 "already satisfied" finding was wrong: tools/editorial_pacing_contract.delivery_clause (called by tools/sd2_provider_prompt_renderer.py and tools/h3_provider_prompt_renderer.py) emitted "对白演绎目标每秒N个汉字" / "N Chinese characters per second" into every dialogue beat of the model-facing prompt (observed in E09 planned SD2 prompts). The clause now carries delivery wording only; cps is still validated and kept in contract metadata (dialogue_delivery) for post-gen ASR comparison

DP6_visible_key_actions.note: No new code; direction_policy_gate.py only asserts this is still wired in each new episode's builder copy.

DP8_identity_reference_sequence.note: No new code; direction_policy_gate.py only asserts this is still wired for each new episode.

W1_cut_point_audio_overlap.implementation: tools/audio_cut_overlap.py — pure filter-graph builder + ffmpeg-gated integration test, both verified
W1_cut_point_audio_overlap.note: Not called from lines/nalu/runtime/tools/nalu_pipeline.py's stage_s7 yet. The existing S7 assembly chain (render -> subtitle burn-in -> endcard -> selective BGM -> loudness leveling) has no verified insertion point for an audio-only crossfade without ffmpeg-level testing against a real rendered episode, and this session had no safe way to do that without risking every future episode's audio. Left off (enabled=false) until wired and verified on a real episode; flip to true only after that.
W1_cut_point_audio_overlap.applies_to: S7 total assembly — intended as a discrete audio-only post-pass after render_portable_timeline.py's validated hard concat; that shared tool's own no-transitions/no-effects rule must never be relaxed

W2_motivated_lighting.status: PARTIAL — renderer accepts and injects plan.lighting_motivation (tools/sd2_provider_prompt_renderer.py), verified; threading each shot's new `lighting` GENERATION_CONTRACT field through the grouping/compile step into plan.lighting_motivation is NOT done this pass — INTEGRATION_PENDING
W2_motivated_lighting.note: Existing lighting field is scene-level free text only; this adds a shot-level motivated-source requirement + a compiled-prompt clause following the existing camera-phrase (_ZH table) idiom. The renderer's optional-field no-op means an absent lighting_motivation changes nothing for any existing episode.
